title: KoViDoRe: Korean Visual Document Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.20840v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal retrieval have improved the ability to retrieve information from visually rich documents such as PDFs and reports. However, existing benchmarks remain largely centered on English and provide limited coverage of Korean visual documents with complex structures. Furthermore, most existing Korean resources primarily evaluate single-page retrieval, failing to capture realistic scenarios that require evidence aggregation across multiple pages. To address these gaps, we introduce KoViDoRe, a benchmark for Korean visual document retrieval. The dataset is constructed from publicly available Korean documents with diverse layouts, including tables, figures, and multi-column structures. We develop a multi-stage data curation pipeline consisting of structured document parsing, synthetic query generation using both summary-based and context-based strategies, and relevance mapping with human verification. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20840v1 公告类型：新 摘要：近期多模态检索的进展提高了从视觉丰富文档（如PDF和报告）中检索信息的能力。然而，现有基准大多以英语为中心，对具有复杂结构的韩语视觉文档覆盖有限。此外，大多数现有韩语资源主要评估单页检索，未能捕捉需要跨多页证据聚合的现实场景。为解决这些不足，我们引入了KoViDoRe，一个韩语视觉文档检索基准。该数据集基于公开可用的韩语文档构建，包含多样化的布局，如表格、图形和多栏结构。我们开发了一个多阶段数据整理流程，包括结构化文档解析、基于摘要和基于上下文的合成查询生成，以及人工验证的相关性映射。使用KoViDoRe，我们进行了广泛实验以评估现有模型性能。
tldr: 本文提出了KoViDoRe，一个针对韩语视觉文档检索的基准数据集，通过多阶段数据整理流程解决了现有基准中韩语复杂文档覆盖不足和单页检索局限的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces KoViDoRe, a benchmark for Korean visual document retrieval, addressing the gaps in Korean complex document coverage and single-page retrieval limitations through a multi-stage data curation pipeline.
